protocol.agent_contract: Only operator_frame is public; truth, analog state, pending queue and RNG checkpoints are privileged

boron.reason: No finite chemical-volume-control supply/letdown tanks or mass-transfer commands in this configuration

charging.reason: Explicit design sizing for added shaft/generator heat at the unchanged hot inventory
charging.thermal_resistance_split: Declared series split; same nominal effective UA, no measured fit

cooling_design.external_source: Prescribed-flow liquid water; external delivery infrastructure outside the plant boundary
cooling_design.source: Constructed nominal sizing, no measured fit

core.state_ownership: Only appended core variables are integrated; legacy neutron slots0..6 are derived aliases
core.thermal_projection: Sum fission source into existing prompt/decay3 heat accounting, then common lumped fuel; no local thermal feedback

snapshot.energy_scale: max(abs(initial stored energy),gross external throughput,1 J)

expansion.outlet_kind: Energy-equivalent condenser inlet including separator drain

snapshot.external_source: Prescribed flow and inlet temperature of external water; no cooling-tower model

feed_design.gas_model: Sealed ideal adiabatic cushions; gas energy included
feed_design.initial_state: Declared hot start; added pump losses create a physical thermal settling transient

source: Dittus F.W., Boelter L.M.K., Univ. California Publ. Eng. 2 (1930), форма, принятая в инженерных справочниках
film.uncertainty: Uncalibrated equivalent tube; no assigned confidence interval

film_geometry.sizing: One nominal UA match at unchanged M/U, clad temperature and actual core volume; not measured geometry

header_bypass.flow_model: IHEM isentropic maximum flux; jet kinetic energy recovered into condenser, no external shaft work

snapshot.jacobian: Fixed relative probes with domain-admitted one-sided fallback
snapshot.phase_scope: Subcooled primary, equilibrium SG/pressurizer reserves; no boiling/CHF prediction

primary.shaft_coordinate: log(omega/omega_nom), old speed slot is a derived alias
primary.zero_head_reference_scope: Frozen instantaneous densities and common steady flow; independent scalar friction solve

condenser_mixture.outlet_kind: Combined LP exhaust and separator drain, not blade-exit wetness

reheater.closure: Secant-cp effectiveness; finite existing SG-wall donor, no independent heat source

staged_turbine.state_ownership: No extra steam/energy reservoir: steady separator/reheater ports, existing SG wall pays heat

steam_design.inherited_sizing: Rotor drag and condenser/cooling sizing retain pre-header SG reference; new header settles dynamically
steam_design.source: Constructed single nominal point, not measured valve/turbine map

steam_header.flow_model: Algebraic one-way small-drop inlet and linear aggregate outlet; finite valve positions and header M/U, no pipe inertia
steam_header.governing: Manual valve positions; no automatic governor or hardware steam-flow map
steam_header.state_ownership: Header M/U and valve positions owned; SG and turbine flows are derived aliases

protocol.scope: Passive hot-state research instruments; linear-between-truth-ticks input, not hardware calibration

limitations: Research instrument parameters and hot-state initialization, not calibrated plant instruments
Consecutive truth frames required; exact lag response applies to linear input between supplied ticks
Operator payload separation is a data contract, not an arbitrary-Python security sandbox
Passive observer only; no controllers, protection arbitration, sensor fault catalog or full R1 duration acceptance
